description: This is a Python source file implementing the database access layer for an asynchronous API, providing connection pooling, query execution, and helper functions for database operations using asyncpg.

methods.name: asyncpg.Pool _create_pool(database_url: str)
methods.description: Creates an asyncpg connection pool with configured parameters.

methods.name: None init_db_pool()
methods.description: Initializes the global database connection pool if the DATABASE_URL is set.

methods.name: None close_db_pool()
methods.description: Closes the global database pool if it exists.

methods.name: asyncpg.Pool _ensure_pool_available()
methods.description: Ensures that the connection pool is available or raises an error if not.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_one(sql: str, *params: Any)
methods.description: Fetches a single record as a dictionary from the database, or None if no record is found.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_all(sql: str, *params: Any)
methods.description: Fetches all matching records as a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: str execute(sql: str, *params: Any)
methods.description: Executes an INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE statement and returns the command status string.

methods.name: List[str] execute_many(sql: str, param_sets: List[Tuple[Any, ...]])
methods.description: Executes a statement multiple times with different parameter sets within a single connection.
